title: Sharktopus vs. Pteracuda
description: A half-shark, half-octopus battles a half-pterodactyl, half-barracuda.

title: Before the Devil Knows You're Dead
description: Events spiral out of control when a man (Philip Seymour Hoffman) ropes his brother (Ethan Hawke) into a scheme to rob their parents' jewelry store.

title: Pacific Heights
description: San Francisco yuppies (Melanie Griffith, Matthew Modine) restore a costly Victorian, then rent a studio to a landlord's nightmare (Michael Keaton).

title: Eraserhead
description: When Henry discovers that a fling with Mary X leaves her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing.

title: Suburbia
description: An overwhelming sense of despair impels a teenager to leave his suburban home and join up with a group of punk rockers.

title: Hoop Dreams
description: Filmmakers chronicle more than four years in the lives of two urban Chicago youths in pursuit of pro basketball stardom.

title: Lawnmower Man 2: Beyond Cyberspace
description: An evil corporation planning an inescapable global computer network hires a mentally impaired laborer (Matt Frewer) made into a genius by virtual reality.

title: Downfall
description: As the Third Reich crumbles around them, Adolf Hitler's secretary witnesses the final 10 days of the Nazi dictator's life.

title: Before I Fall
description: After dying in a car crash, a popular teen (Zoey Deutch) wakes up to mysteriously relive the same fateful day over and over again.

title: The Lawnmower Man
description: A scientist uses an intellectually disabled gardener as a guinea pig in his experiments with intelligence enhancing drugs and virtual reality. The man transforms into a genius, but not without side effects.

title: The General
description: Johnny Gray (Buster Keaton) facing off against Union soldiers during the American Civil War. When Johnny's fiancée, Annabelle Lee (Marion Mack), is accidentally taken away while on a train stolen by Northern forces, Gray pursues the soldiers.

title: City of Industry
description: A retired thief (Harvey Keitel) joins his brother and two accomplices in Los Angeles for a final heist.

title: Justin Bieber's Believe
description: Pop superstar Justin Bieber talks about his music, relationships and growing up in the spotlight. Concert footage, behind-the-scenes access, and appearances by Usher, Ludacris and other performers augment Bieber's narrative.

title: Homegrown
description: A go-between (Kelly Lynch) helps California marijuana growers (Billy Bob Thornton, Hank Azaria) take action when their boss is killed.

title: Steamboat Bill, Jr.
description: A young college student tries to impress his girlfriend while trying to meet the expectations of his father; he is asked to man his girlfriend's father's vessel but doesn't know his bow from his elbow.

title: Two for the Money
description: A former college athlete (Matthew McConaughey) joins forces with a sports consultant (Al Pacino) to handicap football games for high-rolling gamblers.

title: Legionnaire
description: A 1920s playboy returns from a stint in the French Foreign Legion to reclaim his lover, a mobster's mistress.

title: The Grey
description: A pack of hungry wolves pursues survivors (Liam Neeson, Frank Grillo, Dermot Mulroney) of a plane crash, who are trekking through the Alaskan wilderness to find civilization.

title: Fitzcarraldo
description: An Irish dreamer (Klaus Kinski) hauls a huge riverboat overland in his quest for opera in the Amazon.

title: Lancaster Skies
description: A solitary Spitfire ace pilot must overcome his past to lead a Lancaster bomber crew in the pivotal aerial war over Berlin in 1944.

title: Learning to Drive
description: A literary agent (Patricia Clarkson) whose husband left her and a Sikh driving instructor (Ben Kingsley) on the verge of an arranged marriage find that each has something to learn from the other about starting life anew.

title: Insomnia
description: A yuppie (Cristina Marcos) befriends a real estate agent (Ernesto Alterio) engaged to a woman who shops compulsively.

title: Down in the Valley
description: A lawman (David Morse) is suspicious of a charismatic stranger (Edward Norton) who claims to be a former ranch hand and is wooing his teenage daughter (Evan Rachel Wood).

title: My Dinner With Andre
description: A playwright/actor (Wallace Shawn) and a playwright/director (Andre Gregory) have a deep discussion in a restaurant.

title: The Brood
description: A mad doctor tries psychoplasmic therapy on a raging woman soon to be a mother.

title: The Ticket
description: After a sightless man suddenly regains his vision, he is blinded by his obsession with the superficial.

title: JCVD
description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery.

title: The Gambler V: Playing for Keeps
description:
S01 E01
Cardsharp Brady Hawkes searches for his son, who is on the run with outlaws Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid.

title: K-19: The Widowmaker
description: The commander (Harrison Ford) of a Russian submarine tries to avert a disaster after a nuclear reactor malfunctions.

title: Shaolin Wooden Men
description: A fighter vows not to speak until he finds the masked man who killed his father.

title: 10th and Wolf
description: An ex-Marine (James Marsden) faces a dilemma after he returns to South Philadelphia and discovers his brother (Brad Renfro) and cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) are entangled in the mob.

title: Judgment Night
description: On their way to a boxing match, four young men take a wrong turn in Chicago and find danger as witnesses to murder.

title: Crimson Rivers: Angels of the Apocalypse
description: Three investigators (Jean Reno, Benoît Magimel, Camille Natta) track a cloaked killer who possesses superhuman strength and speed.

title: Wish Upon
description: A teen (Joey King) starts to veer down a dark and dangerous path when an old music box grants her wishes that cause those closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.

title: Derailed
description: An undercover operative (Jean-Claude Van Damme) battles terrorists after they seize a train containing biological weapons.

title: Blind Dating
description: After his brother (Eddie Kaye Thomas) sets him up on a series of disastrous dates, a blind man (Chris Pine) falls in love with a nurse (Anjali Jay) from his doctor's office.

title: A Boy and His Dog
description: A young man and his talking canine set out in search of food, shelter and females in a post-apocalyptic wasteland.

title: Creepshow 2
description: A vengeful cigar-store Indian, a flesh-eating creature and a hitchhiker who won't stay dead populate a trilogy of terror.

title: Foreign Correspondent
description: A political assassination plunges an American reporter into international intrigue in pre-World War II Europe.

title: Space Truckers
description: A freight pilot (Dennis Hopper), his girlfriend (Debi Mazar) and an apprentice (Stephen Dorff) try to deliver cargo to Earth in 2197.

title: Dog Soldiers
description: A pack of werewolves targets a squad of soldiers (Sean Pertwee, Kevin McKidd) on a training exercise in the Scottish Highlands.
